metadata.contract_title: Martin Grad reviewed UD/Stanza-to-pedagogical remapping contract
metadata.note: All source wording is preserved. martin_comment contains Martin Grad's comments verbatim, including Slovene comments. No semantic reconciliation has been performed.

cases.example: Sarah and her daughters arrived first.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Direct subject relation maps to S.

reference.example: Sarah and her daughters arrived first.
reference.reference_note: Straightforward direct mapping.

cases.example: The old woman living in the basement needs help.
cases.focus_span: The old woman living in the basement
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: The whole subject phrase maps to S, not only the syntactic head.

reference.example: The old woman living in the basement needs help.
reference.focus_span: The old woman living in the basement
reference.reference_note: The UD head is woman, but the pedagogical span is the whole subject phrase.

cases.example: What he said cannot be denied.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Clausal subject maps to S.
cases.martin_comment: csubj: finite wh-clause (VS. nominal relative clause)

reference.example: What he said cannot be denied.
reference.reference_note: The subordinate clause functions as the subject of the main clause.

cases.example: To have seen him lose his temper was unexpected.
cases.focus_span: To have seen him lose his temper
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Non-finite clausal subject maps to S.
cases.martin_comment: V bistvu je tudi naslednji primer "non-finite clause" - tukaj bi moralo biti infinitival, ali še bolje perfect infinitive clause.

reference.example: To have seen him lose his temper was unexpected.
reference.focus_span: To have seen him lose his temper
reference.reference_note: The infinitival clause fills the subject slot.

cases.example: Writing a letter of application proved difficult.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Gerund-participial clausal subject maps to S.
cases.martin_comment: Če bi se to dalo ločiti (bodisi gerundial bodisi participial - v tem primeru gerundial), bi bilo super, drugače pa ok.

reference.example: Writing a letter of application proved difficult.
reference.reference_note: The -ing clause fills the subject slot.

cases.example: It is important to know the truth.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Expletive it should not be treated like an ordinary lexical S without review.
cases.martin_comment: A pri "postponed clausal S" bi se dalo, da bi bila analiza bolj precizna (i.e., da gre za infinitival clause)?

reference.example: It is important to know the truth.
reference.reference_note: Keep this as a flagged construction rather than a plain nsubj -> S case.

cases.example: Close the door.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Main lexical verb maps to the predicator nucleus.

reference.example: Close the door.
reference.reference_note: Imperative clause with an understood subject; Close is the predicator.

cases.example: Did the children play?
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Auxiliary plus lexical verb together realize P.
cases.martin_comment: Aux v "split predicator" scenariju je operator.

reference.example: Did the children play?
reference.reference_note: The pedagogical predicator may be discontinuous.

cases.example: John was sent a copy of the letter to the president.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Passive auxiliary plus lexical verb together realize P.

reference.example: John was sent a copy of the letter to the president.
reference.reference_note: The remapping should keep the passive auxiliary in the predicator span.

cases.example: Paul is a good student.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: In copular clauses, the copula realizes P and the lexical predicate realizes SC.

reference.example: Paul is a good student.
reference.reference_note: UD usually makes the lexical predicate the head, so this is not a one-label rename.

cases.example: She rang up her mother to ask her to dinner.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Phrasal verb particle should be included in P.

reference.example: She rang up her mother to ask her to dinner.
reference.reference_note: The particle is part of the predicator span.

cases.example: She meant no harm.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: UD obj maps directly to DO.

reference.example: She meant no harm.
reference.reference_note: Straightforward direct object.

cases.example: He hit himself with a golf club.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Reflexive obj maps to DO.

reference.example: He hit himself with a golf club.
reference.reference_note: The reflexive form does not change the sentence-element label.

cases.example: Whom did you see there?
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Wh-object maps to DO even when fronted.

reference.example: Whom did you see there?
reference.reference_note: Word order should not prevent the object mapping.

cases.example: She said that she had lost her purse.
cases.focus_span: that she had lost her purse
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Content clause complement of a verb often functions as clausal DO.

reference.example: She said that she had lost her purse.
reference.focus_span: that she had lost her purse
reference.reference_note: This is derived from the attachment and matrix verb, not from ccomp alone.

cases.example: He said he had lost his mind.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: A content clause without overt that can still function as clausal DO.

reference.example: He said he had lost his mind.
reference.reference_note: The absence of that should not block the mapping.

cases.example: Have you decided what you will study?
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Wh-complement clause can function as clausal DO.

reference.example: Have you decided what you will study?
reference.reference_note: The wh-clause is selected by the matrix verb decided.

cases.ud_stanza_signal: xcomp: -ing complement of a control verb
cases.example: Have you finished reading the newspaper?
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Some non-finite complements are pedagogically treated as clausal DO.

reference.ud_signal: xcomp: -ing complement of a control verb
reference.example: Have you finished reading the newspaper?
reference.correct_mapping: DO or clausal complement, depending on course policy
reference.reference_note: UD xcomp does not always map cleanly to DO; this should be policy-controlled.

cases.example: I found him a vacant flat.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: UD iobj maps to IO.

reference.example: I found him a vacant flat.
reference.reference_note: Recipient/beneficiary object in a double-object pattern.

cases.example: Tell whoever rings me up to call back later.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Fused relative recipient can function as IO.

reference.example: Tell whoever rings me up to call back later.
reference.reference_note: The span is clausal even though the sentence-element function is IO.

cases.example: He gave his wife what he had earned.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Recipient noun phrase in a double-object pattern maps to IO.

reference.example: He gave his wife what he had earned.
reference.reference_note: The second object is the thing transferred; the recipient is IO.

cases.example: The journey was quite pleasant.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Lexical predicate in a copular clause maps to SC.

reference.example: The journey was quite pleasant.
reference.reference_note: UD head is often the adjective, but pedagogically it is SC.

cases.example: Paul is a good student.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Predicate noun phrase after a copula maps to SC.

reference.example: Paul is a good student.
reference.reference_note: The copula maps to P; the complement maps to SC.

cases.example: The furniture in their office is in bad condition.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Predicative PP after a copula maps to SC.

reference.example: The furniture in their office is in bad condition.
reference.reference_note: PP realization does not make it an adverbial here.

cases.example: My advice is to keep your mouth shut.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Infinitival predicate after a copula maps to SC.

reference.example: My advice is to keep your mouth shut.
reference.reference_note: The clause is predicative, not adverbial.

cases.example: His hobby is collecting stamps.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Gerund-participial predicate after a copula maps to SC.

reference.example: His hobby is collecting stamps.
reference.reference_note: The -ing clause identifies the subject.

cases.example: The trouble is that he has no money left.
cases.focus_span: that he has no money left
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Finite content clause after a copula maps to SC.

reference.example: The trouble is that he has no money left.
reference.focus_span: that he has no money left
reference.reference_note: The clause is predicative.

cases.example: The town appeared abandoned.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Predicate after a linking verb maps to SC.
cases.martin_comment: Zgoraj je povsod "copula", tukaj pa se pojavi "linking verb". A to kaj vpliva na funkcionalnost? Pa še ena reč je, in sicer tukaj piše "predicate", v resnici gre pa za adjectivized past participle (e.g., She appears happy.)

reference.example: The town appeared abandoned.
reference.reference_note: Requires a linking-verb rule, not a single UD relation rename.

cases.example: The milk seems off.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Predicate after seem maps to SC.
cases.martin_comment: ditto

reference.example: The milk seems off.
reference.reference_note: The adjective describes the subject, not an object.

cases.example: I consider him my friend.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Predicative complement of an object maps to OC.

reference.example: I consider him my friend.
reference.reference_note: him is DO; my friend describes him.

cases.example: Worries turned his hair white.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Resultative adjective predicated of the object maps to OC.

reference.example: Worries turned his hair white.
reference.reference_note: white describes the object his hair.

cases.example: We found the flat in very good condition.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Predicative PP describing the object maps to OC.
cases.martin_comment: Ta primer je ful zanimiv, ker če določni člen zamenjaš z nedoločnim (a flat), PP postane del DO. A bi to pravilno analiziral?

reference.example: We found the flat in very good condition.
reference.reference_note: The PP is not simply an adverbial of place.

cases.example: I heard her sing.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Bare infinitival predication after an object can map to OC.
cases.martin_comment: Podobno kot pri #36 - če sing zamenjaš z npr. singing, postane her singing DO.

reference.example: I heard her sing.
reference.correct_mapping: OC or clausal object analysis, depending on course policy
reference.reference_note: Perception-verb constructions should be checked against the teaching convention.

cases.example: We found her sitting on the porch.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: -ing predication after an object maps to OC.

reference.example: We found her sitting on the porch.
reference.reference_note: The -ing clause describes the object her.

cases.example: You may call it what you like.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Predicative complement of object it maps to OC.

reference.example: You may call it what you like.
reference.reference_note: The complement gives the name/description assigned to the object.

cases.example: They fought bravely.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Adverbial modifier maps to A.

reference.example: They fought bravely.
reference.reference_note: Direct adverbial mapping.

cases.example: He jumped for joy.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Non-core oblique PP maps to A when it modifies the event.

reference.example: He jumped for joy.
reference.reference_note: Function is adverbial, regardless of PP form.

cases.example: The journey lasted an entire month.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Duration phrase maps to A even if UD treatment varies.

reference.example: The journey lasted an entire month.
reference.reference_note: Duration objects are a common edge case for automatic mapping.

cases.example: Yesterday I helped my brother prepare lunch.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Temporal adverbial maps to A.

reference.example: Yesterday I helped my brother prepare lunch.
reference.reference_note: Fronted position does not affect function.

cases.example: The emigrant returned home to die.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Purpose infinitive maps to A.
cases.martin_comment: Tukaj bi moral biti tudi home označen kot A.

reference.example: The emigrant returned home to die.
reference.reference_note: Non-finite clause expresses purpose.

cases.example: He was late because the traffic was so dense.
cases.focus_span: because the traffic was so dense
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Finite adverbial clause maps to A.

reference.example: He was late because the traffic was so dense.
reference.focus_span: because the traffic was so dense
reference.reference_note: because marks a causal adverbial clause.

cases.example: Knowing my temper, I didn't reply.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Reduced adverbial clause maps to A.

reference.example: Knowing my temper, I didn't reply.
reference.reference_note: The clause gives background/reason information.

cases.example: She telephoned while you were out.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: The root clause maps to the main clause layer.

reference.example: She telephoned while you were out.
reference.reference_note: The subordinate clause is embedded under the main clause.

cases.example: I noticed that he spoke English with an Australian accent.
cases.focus_span: that he spoke English with an Australian accent
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Finite content clause maps to nominal clause; function is derived from attachment.

reference.example: I noticed that he spoke English with an Australian accent.
reference.focus_span: that he spoke English with an Australian accent
reference.reference_note: ccomp alone is not enough; the higher verb decides the function.

cases.example: I think you have some influence on her.
cases.focus_span: you have some influence on her
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Zero-that content clause maps to nominal clause.

reference.example: I think you have some influence on her.
reference.focus_span: you have some influence on her
reference.reference_note: The marker is zero, but the clause type remains nominal/content.

cases.example: I have heard that you are a car mechanic and that your brother is a plumber.
cases.focus_span: that you are a car mechanic / that your brother is a plumber
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Each coordinated content clause should be represented separately.

reference.example: I have heard that you are a car mechanic and that your brother is a plumber.
reference.focus_span: that you are a car mechanic / that your brother is a plumber
reference.correct_mapping: Two nominal clauses functioning together as DO
reference.reference_note: The remapper should not collapse coordinated subordinate clauses into one opaque span.

cases.example: What you want is impossible.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Wh/fused relative clause can function as subject.
cases.martin_comment: "Wh/fused relative"? To je ponovno nominal relative clause (same as #7).

reference.example: What you want is impossible.
reference.reference_note: The clause fills the subject position.

cases.example: Whether he will agree is not certain.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Whether-clause can function as subject.
cases.martin_comment: Mi to imenujemo dependent verbal question.

reference.example: Whether he will agree is not certain.
reference.reference_note: The clause is nominal in type and subject in function.

cases.example: The fact that he is now old and weak must be taken into consideration.
cases.focus_span: that he is now old and weak
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Content clause after a noun maps to nominal clause and postmodifier function.
cases.martin_comment: To je v bistvu appositive clause, ki se nekoliko razlikuje od klasičnih PostM.

reference.example: The fact that he is now old and weak must be taken into consideration.
reference.focus_span: that he is now old and weak
reference.correct_mapping: Nominal content clause functioning as postmodifier
reference.reference_note: The clause modifies fact.

cases.example: The question whether the atom can or cannot be split has interested scientists for decades.
cases.focus_span: whether the atom can or cannot be split
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Whether content clause after a noun maps to postmodifier.
cases.martin_comment: ditto

reference.example: The question whether the atom can or cannot be split has interested scientists for decades.
reference.focus_span: whether the atom can or cannot be split
reference.correct_mapping: Nominal content clause functioning as postmodifier
reference.reference_note: The clause modifies question.

cases.example: My advice is that you should apply for the job.
cases.focus_span: that you should apply for the job
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Predicative content clause maps to subject complement.

reference.example: My advice is that you should apply for the job.
reference.focus_span: that you should apply for the job
reference.reference_note: The clause is predicative after the copula.

cases.example: I am not sure what he wants.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Adjective complements are nominal clauses, but their sentence-element function needs a policy decision.
cases.martin_comment: V tem primeru ima funkcijo PostM (pridevnika sure).

reference.example: I am not sure what he wants.
reference.reference_note: This may not map cleanly to S/DO/SC/A/postmodifier.

cases.example: I am sorry that I couldn't meet you at the station.
cases.focus_span: that I couldn't meet you at the station
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: That-clause after an adjective should be retained as a nominal clause, with function reviewed.
cases.martin_comment: ditto

reference.example: I am sorry that I couldn't meet you at the station.
reference.focus_span: that I couldn't meet you at the station
reference.reference_note: Course policy should decide how to label this function.

cases.example: She telephoned while you were out.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Temporal while-clause maps to adverbial clause.
cases.martin_comment: Namesto "maps to adverbial clause" bi moralo biti "maps to A"?

reference.example: She telephoned while you were out.
reference.reference_note: The marker supplies temporal subtype.

cases.example: I can't go out with you because I am studying this evening.
cases.focus_span: because I am studying this evening
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Causal because-clause maps to adverbial clause.
cases.martin_comment: ditto

reference.example: I can't go out with you because I am studying this evening.
reference.focus_span: because I am studying this evening
reference.reference_note: The clause gives reason/cause.

cases.example: Since it is your fault, you should apologize.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Causal since-clause maps to adverbial clause.
cases.martin_comment: ditto

reference.example: Since it is your fault, you should apologize.
reference.reference_note: since is causal here, not temporal.

cases.example: If it weren't so cold, it would be nice.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Conditional if-clause maps to adverbial clause.
cases.martin_comment: ditto

reference.example: If it weren't so cold, it would be nice.
reference.reference_note: Marker gives conditional subtype.

cases.example: Unless she studies harder, she won't pass the exam.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Negative conditional unless-clause maps to adverbial clause.
cases.martin_comment: ditto

reference.example: Unless she studies harder, she won't pass the exam.
reference.reference_note: Marker gives negative condition subtype.

cases.example: Although it was cold and rainy, we enjoyed the trip.
cases.focus_span: Although it was cold and rainy
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Concessive although-clause maps to adverbial clause.
cases.martin_comment: ditto

reference.example: Although it was cold and rainy, we enjoyed the trip.
reference.focus_span: Although it was cold and rainy
reference.reference_note: Marker gives concessive subtype.

cases.example: They are working night and day so that they may open the subway at the scheduled time.
cases.focus_span: so that they may open the subway at the scheduled time
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Purpose/result so-that clause maps to adverbial clause.
cases.martin_comment: ditto + samo "purpose" (result/consequence je druga vrsta)

reference.example: They are working night and day so that they may open the subway at the scheduled time.
reference.focus_span: so that they may open the subway at the scheduled time
reference.reference_note: Subtype should be inferred from context and marker.

cases.example: Wherever he went, he was welcome.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Place/free-choice wherever-clause maps to adverbial clause.
cases.martin_comment: ditto

reference.example: Wherever he went, he was welcome.
reference.reference_note: Marker gives place/free-choice subtype.

cases.example: He spends his money as if he were rich.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Manner/comparison as-if clause maps to adverbial clause.

reference.example: He spends his money as if he were rich.
reference.reference_note: Subtype should be retained if the course uses it.

cases.example: She was as friendly as she had ever been.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Comparative clause maps to adverbial/comparative clause.
cases.martin_comment: Ta v resnici nima funkcije stavčnega člena (A), ampak je PostM (pridevniku "friendly").

reference.example: She was as friendly as she had ever been.
reference.correct_mapping: Comparative subordinate clause functioning as A
reference.reference_note: Comparatives are often parsed differently and should be checked.

cases.example: Entering the room, he noticed that the windows were open.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: -ing adverbial clause maps to adverbial clause.
cases.martin_comment: Ker gre za supplementive clause (ki je non-finite), je včasih težko določiti vrsto A.

reference.example: Entering the room, he noticed that the windows were open.
reference.reference_note: Non-finite structure should be recorded.

cases.example: On arriving at the cottage, Tom found it burnt down.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Prepositional -ing clause maps to adverbial clause.

reference.example: On arriving at the cottage, Tom found it burnt down.
reference.reference_note: The preposition is part of the marker/structure cue.

cases.example: She rang up her mother to ask her to dinner.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Purpose infinitive maps to adverbial clause.

reference.example: She rang up her mother to ask her to dinner.
reference.reference_note: Non-finite purpose clause.

cases.example: Although always helpful, he was not much liked.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Verbless concessive clause maps to adverbial clause.

reference.example: Although always helpful, he was not much liked.
reference.correct_mapping: Reduced adverbial clause functioning as A
reference.reference_note: Automatic parsers may not expose this as a full clause consistently.

cases.example: Even if still working, the engine is not reliable.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Reduced conditional/concessive clause maps to adverbial clause.

reference.example: Even if still working, the engine is not reliable.
reference.correct_mapping: Reduced adverbial clause functioning as A
reference.reference_note: Marker and missing verb make this a review case.

cases.example: Students who work hard pass their exams.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Relative clause maps to postmodifier of the noun.

reference.example: Students who work hard pass their exams.
reference.correct_mapping: Restrictive relative clause functioning as postmodifier
reference.reference_note: who marks the relative clause; it restricts students.

cases.example: The record I am listening to is a present from Moscow.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Zero relative clause maps to relative postmodifier.

reference.example: The record I am listening to is a present from Moscow.
reference.correct_mapping: Restrictive zero relative clause functioning as postmodifier
reference.reference_note: Zero relatives require span recovery beyond the overt marker.

cases.example: Our granny of whom we were very fond died unexpectedly.
cases.focus_span: of whom we were very fond
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Prepositional relative pronoun maps to relative clause.

reference.example: Our granny of whom we were very fond died unexpectedly.
reference.focus_span: of whom we were very fond
reference.reference_note: The marker is complex: preposition + whom.

cases.example: I could see no reason why I should refuse a drink.
cases.focus_span: why I should refuse a drink
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Relative adverb why maps to relative clause.

reference.example: I could see no reason why I should refuse a drink.
reference.focus_span: why I should refuse a drink
reference.reference_note: The clause modifies reason.

cases.example: We could find no place where we could talk in peace.
cases.focus_span: where we could talk in peace
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Relative adverb where maps to relative clause.

reference.example: We could find no place where we could talk in peace.
reference.focus_span: where we could talk in peace
reference.reference_note: The clause modifies place.

cases.example: I liked the present which Mrs. Thompson sent me.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Which-relative maps to relative postmodifier.

reference.example: I liked the present which Mrs. Thompson sent me.
reference.correct_mapping: Restrictive relative clause functioning as postmodifier
reference.reference_note: which is the relative marker.

cases.example: He is no longer the man he was.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Zero relative clause maps to postmodifier.

reference.example: He is no longer the man he was.
reference.reference_note: Zero marker and predicative content make automatic recovery non-trivial.

cases.example: Any person who wishes to see me must take an appointment.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Restrictive relatives narrow the reference of the antecedent.
cases.martin_comment: maps to PostM

reference.example: Any person who wishes to see me must take an appointment.
reference.reference_note: No commas and semantic restriction support restrictive interpretation.

cases.example: The giant panda, which is to be found in the remote parts of China, lives exclusively on bamboo shoots.
cases.focus_span: which is to be found in the remote parts of China
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Non-restrictive relatives add parenthetical information.

reference.example: The giant panda, which is to be found in the remote parts of China, lives exclusively on bamboo shoots.
reference.focus_span: which is to be found in the remote parts of China
reference.reference_note: Commas and appositive meaning support non-restrictive interpretation.

cases.example: The following day which was Friday he left for Belgrade.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Restrictiveness cannot be reliably inferred when punctuation is unreliable or removed.
cases.martin_comment: Čeprav je brez vejic, gre za non-restrictive clause.

reference.example: The following day which was Friday he left for Belgrade.
reference.correct_mapping: Probably non-restrictive, but manual review required
reference.reference_note: Do not rely only on punctuation for this exercise type.

cases.example: She said that she had lost her purse.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: that in a content clause maps to complementizer marker.
cases.martin_comment: #82-#92 ne razumem 🤔

reference.example: She said that she had lost her purse.
reference.reference_note: Marker type, not sentence-element function.

cases.example: Time will show whether we are right or wrong.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: whether marks an embedded interrogative/content clause.

reference.example: Time will show whether we are right or wrong.
reference.reference_note: Keep marker type separate from clause function.

cases.example: The question is if he feels up to the task.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: if can mark an embedded interrogative/content clause.

reference.example: The question is if he feels up to the task.
reference.reference_note: if must be distinguished from conditional if.

cases.example: If it weren't so cold, it would be nice.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: conditional if maps to subordinating conjunction marker.

reference.example: If it weren't so cold, it would be nice.
reference.reference_note: Different function from nominal if.

cases.example: As it was raining, we stayed indoors all day.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Causal adverbial markers map to subordinating conjunction.

reference.example: As it was raining, we stayed indoors all day.
reference.reference_note: The lexical marker helps infer adverbial subtype.

cases.example: While he has invested a lot of money in paintings, he doesn't understand very much about art.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Concessive adverbial markers map to subordinating conjunction.

reference.example: While he has invested a lot of money in paintings, he doesn't understand very much about art.
reference.reference_note: while here is concessive, not temporal.

cases.example: Students who work hard pass their exams.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Relative pronoun maps to relative marker type.

reference.example: Students who work hard pass their exams.
reference.reference_note: Marker type should be stored separately from clause function.

cases.example: We could find no place where we could talk in peace.
cases.remapping_rule_to_check: Relative adverb maps to relative marker type.

reference.example: We could find no place where we could talk in peace.
